guidance: Astra completed the sleeping setup. Player HP77/84, Strength3, Vicious1, zero energy, Dexterity Potion available. Lagavulin Matriarch HP222, 11 Block, Asleep1, Sleep intent, Vulnerable1. First end this spent turn. In active combat, prioritize recurring Thrumming Hatchet (returns next turn) for reliable damage, Uppercut+ Weak2 when facing substantial attacks, and Vulnerable to amplify damage and trigger Vicious draw. Use Dexterity Potion early if it meaningfully reduces repeated incoming damage; do not hoard at risk of death. True Grit randomly exhausts another hand card, so avoid it when Hatchet or other key cards could be lost unless necessary for immediate survival. Check actual intent/block/statuses each turn; do not assume a sleeping or stunned boss attacks. Pause for Astra at or below 45 HP before spending energy. Rewards should be evaluated for Act2 survival/scaling, but the cap may stop before that.
